Data Scientist

The Opportunity:

As a data scientist, you're excited at the prospect of unlocking the secrets held by a data set, and you're fascinated by the possibilities presented by IoT, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. In an increasingly connected world, massive amounts of structured and unstructured data open new opportunities. As a data scientist at Booz Allen, you can help turn these complex data sets into useful information to solve global challenges. Across private and public sectors-from fraud detection to cancer research to national intelligence-we need you to help find the answers in the data.

On our team, you'll use your leadership skills and data science expertise to create real-world impact. You'll work closely with clients to understand their questions and needs, and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. You'll guide teammates and lead the development of algorithms and systems. You'll use the right combination of tools and frameworks to turn sets of disparate data points into objective answers to advise your clients as they make informed decisions. Ultimately, you'll provide a deep understanding of the data, what it all means, and how it can be used.

Work with us as we use data science for good.

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:
• Experience with data exploration, data cleaning, data analysis, data visualization, or data mining
• Experience with statistical and general-purpose programming languages for data analysis
• Experience analyzing structured and unstructured data sources
• Experience developing predictive data models, quantitative analyses, and visualization of targeted data sources
• Experience leading the development of solutions to complex programs
• Experience with natural language processing, text mining, or machine learning techniques
• Bachelor's degree

Nice If You Have:
• Experience in the development of algorithms leveraging R, Python, or SQL/NoSQL
• Experience with visualization packages
• Experience with big data platform development and analytics, and supporting the development of products from varied, multi-source, and large data sources
• Experience developing scripts, procedures, and processes for extracting and processing data using existing tools and capabilities to derive data-driven analytic insights to support mission requirements
• Experience with Smartsheet administration and development
• Experience with implementing modern software development practices and approaches, including Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery, or DevOps to develop custom software or scripting products
• Experience with developing RPA in UI Path
• Knowledge of three core financial statements, including income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statement, and the linkages between them
• Possession of excellent verbal and written communication skills, including presentation skills
• Master's degree in Data Science

Create Your Career:

Grow With Us

Your growth matters to us-that's why we offer a variety of ways for you to develop your career. With professional and leadership development opportunities like upskilling programs, tuition reimbursement, mentoring, and firm-sponsored networking, you can chart a unique and fulfilling career path on your own terms.

A Place Where You Belong

Diverse perspectives cultivate collective ingenuity. Booz Allen's culture of respect, equity, and opportunity means that, here, you are free to bring your whole self to work. With an array of business resource groups and other opportunities for connection, you'll build your community in no time.

Support Your Well-Being

Our comprehensive benefits package includes wellness programs with HSA contributions, paid holidays, paid parental leave, a generous 401(k) match, and more. With these benefits, plus the option for flexible schedules and remote and hybrid locations, we'll support you as you pursue a balanced, fulfilling life-at work and at home.

At Booz Allen, we know our people are what propel us forward, and we value relationships most of all. Here, we've compiled a list of resources so you'll know what to expect as we forge a connection with you during your journey as a candidate with us.

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

What We Do

Max is the “One to Watch” Streaming App from Warner Bros Discovery featuring the largest and the critically acclaimed catalog from brands like HBO, CNN, Discovery, A24, Food Network and many more. At Max, the Growth Engineering team comprises ML engineers, data scientists, and software engineers. Our goal is to boost engagement and grow the number of active subscribers. · Self-motivated, growth-oriented, and driven to pursue excellence across teams

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

About DrFirst

Here is a remarkable chance for you to join a thriving Healthcare IT company with established products, prestigious clients, substantial revenue, blue-chip institutional investors, and continuous growth. At DrFirst, you will collaborate with brilliant minds, tackling unique healthcare challenges on an unprecedented scale. Our culture is entrepreneurial, collaborative, and fast-paced—ideal for those who seek personal and professional growth while working alongside intelligent colleagues. If you're enthusiastic about pushing your limits, unlocking your potential, and thriving in a dynamic team, we're eager to connect with you!

Position Overview

We are seeking a skilled Data Scientist to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for analyzing large datasets to uncover insights that drive strategic decisions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop predictive models and algorithms to address business challenges, identify actionable opportunities, and design innovative and intelligent data-driven solutions. Strong expertise in machine learning, data mining, and statistical analysis is essential. Proven experience in applying machine learning and AI techniques to real-world problems a must. A background in healthcare is preferred, as you will be working on projects that directly impact patient care and safety.

Who will love this job
• A Driver who works with purpose and passion; someone who is disciplined and motivated to perform on the job in a 100% remote work environment
• A Builder who enjoys building skills, products, processes, systems, and structures as well as optimizing existing ones
• A Communicator who communicate effectively while working 100% remotely, who can explain technical decisions and design to team members, stakeholders and non-technical colleagues.
• A Learner who has a growth mindset, stays up on their craft, and always has an eye out for what is coming next.

What you will work on
• Develop and Implement Machine Learning Models:
• Design, develop, and implement machine learning models and algorithms to solve specific problem.
• Our technologists, no matter what level, never go hands off. We think it’s important to be close to the technology and solutions, to have a line of sight into how our models integrate with the products. Our data scientist team is involved in all aspects of the model building process, from conception to deployment
• Continuously evaluate and improve the performance of models.
• Data Analysis and Insight Generation:
• Work closely with the team to understand business problems and translate them into data-driven solutions.
• Analyze large datasets (structured and unstructured) to discover trends, patterns, and relationships.
• Maintain and Optimize Data Pipelines:
• Collaborate with project team to identify relevant data sources for specific projects.
• Assist in automating data collection processes from various sources.
• Collaborate with data analysts to perform data cleaning, pre-processing, and validation to ensure data quality and accuracy.
• Collaborate with data engineers to maintain and optimize data pipelines, ensuring data integrity and availability for analysis and model development.
• Communication and Collaboration:
• Participate in discussions with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate data insights into actionable recommendations.
• Effectively communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences through data visualization techniques.
• Collaborate with engineers and product development teams to integrate data-driven solutions into existing systems.
• Document data collection, analysis, and modeling processes for knowledge sharing and reproducibility.
• Problem solving and Learning:
• The problems we are solving are unique and complex. This takes critical thinking, root cause analysis, and issue dissection with the team to produce the best solution. You will be at the forefront, translating business problems into technical approaches and designs that yield actionable recommendations to enhance and drive products/solutions.
• Proactively learn and stay updated on the latest data science tools, techniques, and best practices.
• Continuously improve programming and software development skills relevant to data science.

Qualifications
• Can use different query languages like SQL or NoSQL (Elasticsearch, DynamoDB, etc) to collect, clean, manipulate, and transform data
• Proficiency in Python, particularly libraries like pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn. Familiarity with R may also be beneficial.
• Strong experience with machine learning frameworks and libraries such as TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-Learn, PyTorch, and OpenCV.
• Strong foundation in statistical concepts like hypothesis testing, A/B testing, regression analysis, and probability distributions.
• Strong experience with different ML models (clustering, classification, regression, preprocessing);
• Understand how common deep learning ML models work (Deep Neural Network, Recurrent Neural Networks, Transformers), with different domains (text, images, tabular, time series).
• Hands-on experience throughout entire ML process: from data collection and transform, to model training and evaluation, to model deployment.
• Basic software engineering skills: with Python can build APIs serving ML models and APIs that transform data, can interact with AWS, Kubernetes, Linux, bash
• Skills to create clear and informative visualizations to communicate insights to both technical and non-technical audiences. Expertise in data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Matplotlib.
• Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.
• Familiarity with SDLC, Agile, and issue tracking. Experience with version control systems like Git.
• A minimum of 1-2 years of experience in a data science role (can be adjusted based on the seniority you require). No upper limit on experience. Salary will vary depending on level of experience.
• Nice to have: experience with big data technologies such as Hadoop, Spark, or similar.
• Nice to have: Familiarity with healthcare data standards, regulations, and best practices, is a plus.
• Master’s or Ph.D. in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.

Physical Requirements
• 10% Travel
• 60% Desk work
• 30% Phone work

Benefits

We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy as you grow in your life and career. Your merit-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers.

Learn more about our benefits and professional development opportunities at www.drfirst.com.

The Data Scientist, Research Sciences role at Sarepta is an exciting opportunity for someone with strong data science and analytical skills who wants to see their work directly impacting patient care. In this hands-on role, the data scientist will research and develop advanced analytical methods to utilize internal and external chemistry and biological data to support all therapeutic modalities, including RNA, gene replacement, and gene editing therapies. As a data scientist, you will get exposure to the entire drug development process and collaborate with bench and computational scientists to develop and execute data solutions to support scientific projects. It is a fantastic opportunity to work at the forefront of precision genetic medicine, impacting the development of transformative therapies that may change patient's lives. Primary Responsibilities Include
• Develop an interface to manage the chemical data registration system, platforms for assay configuration and data capture, synthesis planning, inventory, and experimental tracking.
• Develop and implement AI and machine learning models to utilize internal and external experimental data and identify novel drug-like chemical structures.
• Collaborate with medicinal chemists and research biologists to develop advanced data analysis strategies, and data visualizations, implement dashboard solutions, and leverage additional technologies for effective data utilization.
• Contribute to the design and optimization of next-generation medicines by applying in-depth knowledge of structure-activity relationships, a profound understanding of target biology, and predictive methods for assessing on and off-target activity, physical properties, synthetic feasibility for RNA, gene replacement, and gene editing therapies.
• Collaborating with other scientists, evaluate and adopt proprietary and open-source tools to improve chemoinformatic workflows.
• Collaborate with additional Research and Development functions including the Immunology, Translational Biology, Research Operations, and External Innovation groups to identify, design, and execute data-related pipelines, analyses, and visualizations.
• Adhere to data governance policies, regulatory requirements, licensing policies, and other industry best practices for data handling, coding, and application development.
• Maintain and develop a well-documented codebase and documentation for computational and bioinformatics solutions and applications.
• Perform additional related tasks as assigned. Desired Education and Skills
• MS/PhD in Computational Chemistry, Bioinformatics, Computer Science, Biomedical/Software Engineering, or related field, plus 1-2 years of relevant experience, preferably in the biotech/pharma industry. A background in chemistry and/or chemical informatics is strongly preferred.
• Deep knowledge of advanced statistical methods and algorithms; and AI/ML applications on biological and chemistry data.
• Advanced programming/scripting abilities in languages such as R, Python, and SQL. The ability to code in other languages is a plus.
• Experience working with scientific platforms such as Schrödinger, CCG, OpenEye, PipelinePilot, as well as modeling software, such as GOLD, OMEGA, MOE, ESMFold, AlphaFold, RoseTTAFold, GROMACS, Amber would be preferred.
• Experience with data visualization tools, including R Shiny (strongly preferred), Power BI, and/or Tableau.
• Experience working with cloud computing services, database systems, workflow management systems, and development tools in a production environment: AWS, Docker, Nextflow, GitLab, and database technologies.
• Experience in programmatically interfacing with the database via APIs, FTPs, or remote servers.
• Ability to effectively communicate and work with a multidisciplinary team including chemists, biologists, geneticists, data scientists, and clinical scientists, to complete scientific projects.

• Strong team player, excellent communicator, and continuous learner. LI-Remote

Let’s do something that really matters.
